evidence.title: Verifier judgments changed under abstraction and often recovered when provenance was restored
evidence.observation: The preprint reports verification failures after execution evidence was represented across abstraction boundaries. Restoring corresponding execution provenance recovered many measured failures, with lower recovery from lossy or unavailable provenance.
evidence.evidence_standing: Source-reported bounded observation; not independently verified by Commons

evidence.limitations: Controlled research and abstract-level inspection. Recovery rates are conditional on the tested failures and representations, not field accuracy estimates.

evidence.support_assessment: Commons interpretation: One view can support a correct judgment that another view of the same execution does not.
